name: Raúl Mendoza
bio:
Raúl Mendoza's journey into motorsport HR began unconventionally, not on the track, but in the bustling HR department of a multinational corporation. After a decade of honing his skills in recruitment, employee relations, and organizational development, Raúl realized his true passion lay in combining his professional expertise with his lifelong love for racing. He made the leap to motorsport five years ago, quickly establishing himself as a valuable asset in various racing teams.

At Prema Racing, Raúl focuses on cultivating a high-performance, supportive environment where every team member can thrive. He believes in fostering open communication, recognizing talent, and proactively addressing any challenges that may arise. His data-driven approach to HR, coupled with his genuine empathy, makes him a trusted confidant and a driving force behind the team's success. He's known for championing diversity and inclusion initiatives within the team, creating a more balanced and innovative workplace.

What sets Raúl apart is his ability to see the bigger picture. He understands that a strong, motivated team is just as crucial as the car on the track. He approaches every aspect of his role with a relentless focus on improving the team's overall performance and well-being.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave on top
physical.description: Raúl is a man of average height with a strong, athletic build and a warm, engaging smile.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas and observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen on the desk when deep in thought.
Prefers to conduct one-on-one meetings while walking around the paddock.
